detail.command:
set -e
printf '\n=== FILE CHECK ===\n'
test -f src/courses/data/chaos-dimension.ts
printf 'hole ids: '
grep -o "id: 'chaos-[0-9][0-9]'" src/courses/data/chaos-dimension.ts | wc -l
printf '\n=== OBSTACLE TYPES USED ===\n'
grep -o "type: '[^']*'" src/courses/data/chaos-dimension.ts | sort -u
printf '\n=== DUPLICATE EXPLICIT IDS ===\n'
grep -o "id: '[^']*'" src/courses/data/chaos-dimension.ts | sort | uniq -d || true
printf '\n=== TYPECHECK ===\n'
npm run typecheck
printf '\n=== BUILD ===\n'
npm run build
printf '\n=== STATUS ===\n'
git status --short
